import pathlib, re, subprocess, sys
naskah = sys.argv[1]
p = pathlib.Path(naskah)
m = re.search('Sesi\\s*(\\d+)', p.name, re.I)
if not m:
    print('no sesi number found in naskah filename: ' + naskah, file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
sesi = m.group(1).zfill(2)
proc = subprocess.run(['node', '/Users/flp9damarpramuditya/.agent-tools/rps-deck/deck.mjs', 'status', str(p.parent)], capture_output=True, text=True)
if proc.returncode != 0:
    print('rps-deck status failed: ' + proc.stderr, file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
line = None
for l in proc.stdout.split('\n'):
    if l.strip().startswith('Sesi ' + sesi + ' '):
        line = l
        break
if line is None:
    print('no status row for Sesi ' + sesi + ' in ' + str(p.parent), file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
ready = ('naskah: approved' in line) and ('slides: yes' in line) and ('materi: yes' in line)
if not ready:
    print('Sesi ' + sesi + ' not ready: ' + line.strip(), file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
print('Sesi ' + sesi + ' approved with Slides and Materi present: ' + line.strip())
